matches.reason: It writes first messages to possible resellers, which overlaps with a partner introduction, but not a full one-pager.

bullets.label: Closest match
bullets.text: Partner Outreach Drafts is in pilot with Partnerships until January 10. It writes first messages, not a one-pager, but it already knows our partner tiers. It may be easier to extend it than to start a new tool.

bullets.label: Information
bullets.text: Internal notes on partner tiers and deal registration, plus public product information. No customer details.

bullets.label: Shared use
bullets.text: Several teams would use it, so the one-pager would need an owner who keeps tier details current.

bullets.label: Worth asking
bullets.text: Is the tier and deal registration information written down somewhere the tool could read, or would reps paste it in each time?

use_existing.reason: Partner Outreach Drafts is already in pilot with Partnerships and knows our partner tiers. Theo Grant has agreed to add a one-pager option during the pilot, so you can try it there first.
use_existing.what_would_change: If the one-pager needs content the outreach tool can't handle, like deal registration steps, tell us and we'll look at a separate tool.

approve.reason: Approved. A one-page overview for new reseller partners uses internal and public information only, and a person reviews each one before it's shared. It starts as a pilot with Partnerships.
approve.what_would_change: If partners need custom pricing in the one-pager, ask again since that would use deal details.

approve_with_limits.reason: Approved with a limit. You can draft partner one-pagers, but tier and deal registration details must come from the current partner guide so every partner sees the same terms.
approve_with_limits.what_would_change: If the partner guide moves somewhere the tool can read it directly, we can look at lifting this limit.

not_approved.reason: We're not approving this as a separate tool right now. Partner Outreach Drafts is still in pilot, and we'd like to see how it does before adding a second partner writing tool.
not_approved.what_would_change: When the outreach pilot ends on January 10, ask again and we'll look at this with what we've learned.
